tweetText: Researchers introduced ABBEL, a new way to teach LLMs to use "belief states" instead of long conversation histories. This allows AI to handle complex, long-term tasks without running out of memory. via BAIR Berkeley
Physical AI models may soon use brain wave data to learn how to move. This could help robots understand human actions much more effectively. via TechCrunch AI
Moonshot AI’s Kimi model caused a stir in Silicon Valley and Wall Street. It shows how quickly Chinese AI startups can disrupt global markets. via TechCrunch AI

Hugging Face's CEO is calling for radical transparency following a major hack involving an autonomous AI agent. This highlights the urgent need for better security as AI systems gain more independence. via TechCrunch AI
